description: Sends Commlo the user's report that a commute answer, a missing address, or coverage is wrong. Use only when the user asks to report it. Do not offer or mention reporting otherwise. Do not include names, emails or phone numbers. Returns a reference id.

inputSchema.description: One report. Exactly one of address_id or address_text. At most one of window_id, arrive_by, or depart_after, as in the question asked.

address_id.description: The address_id from the answer, when there was one.

address_text.description: The address as the user gave it, when there is no address_id.

arrive_by.description: The arrive_by time asked about, if any.

depart_after.description: The depart_after time asked about, if any.

description.description: What the user says is wrong, in plain words.

direction.description: The direction asked about, if any.

expected.description: What the user expected instead, if they said.

route_id.description: The route_id of the option that looks wrong, if any.

service_date.description: The service date of the answer.

station_id.description: The station_id of the option that looks wrong, if any.

terminal_id.description: The downtown terminal asked about, if any.

trip_id.description: The trip_id of the train that looks wrong, if any.

window_id.description: The window asked about, if any.

name: report_issue

enum: The page cursor is not valid.
No service is available for that request.
That address is outside Commlo coverage.
No Metra station matches that name or ID.
This contract version is not supported.

reference_id.description: The reference of the stored report.

title: Report issue
